claims.label: ACCEPTED
claims.statement: The one-node inequality and its all-depth fresh-selector telescope are correct with coefficients 1 and 3/ln2 for arbitrary shared Boolean terminal data.

claims.label: PROVED
claims.statement: The theorem gives one raw difference-entropy entry per node but does not prove disjoint physical ownership of those entries; reused selector coordinates can make the formal node sum differ from actual physical influence.

claims.label: OPEN
claims.statement: The aggregate raw difference entropy has a dimension-independent nonreused payment by data influence and terminal entropy in arbitrary changing-core hierarchies.
